name: Raghurajpur Pattachitra Heritage Village
description: India's first declared Heritage Crafts Village where every home is an active artisan studio. Preserves 5th-century Pattachitra cloth scroll painting and palm-leaf engraving.
ticketPrice: Free Entry (Donations to Artisan Guild encouraged)
nearestTransit: Chandanpur Bus Stop (1.8 km) / Puri Railway (12 km)

name: Konark Sun Temple (The Black Pagoda)
description: UNESCO World Heritage Site built in 1250 CE by King Narasimhadeva I. A colossal 24-wheeled chariot of Surya calculating solar time accurately.
nearestTransit: Konark Bus Stand (0.5 km) / Puri (35 km)

name: Ratnagiri & Lalitgiri Buddhist Viharas
description: Premier Buddhist academic monastic seat (5th-12th century CE) celebrated for its green chlorite carved portal and Tantric Vajrayana stupas.
nearestTransit: Cuttack Railway (70 km) / Jajpur Keonjhar Road (45 km)

name: Dhauli Peace Pagoda & Ashokan Rock Edicts
description: Site of the Great Kalinga War (261 BCE) on the banks of River Daya, where Emperor Ashoka renounced violence and embraced Buddhism.
